# Twent Docs

> Step-by-step guides for Twent AI agent on Android — automate apps, run Ubuntu terminal & connect 1000+ services.

# Introduction
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs

Twent runs on **Android 8.0+** and gives you a real AI assistant that can see your screen, control any app, run shell commands, browse the web, manage files, and connect to external tools — all from a floating bubble or the main chat interface.

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Installation" href="/getting-started/installation" icon="download">
    Download the APK and install Twent on your device.
  </Card>
  <Card title="First Setup" href="/getting-started/first-setup" icon="settings">
    Configure your AI provider and start chatting.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Tools" href="/tools/overview" icon="wrench">
    40+ built-in tools — file system, shell, web, media, UI automation.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Workflows" href="/workflows/overview" icon="zap">
    Multi-step automations with triggers and conditions.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## Why Twent exists

Most AI assistants live in a chat bubble and can't touch your device. Twent is different — it runs **on your phone** with full access to the OS, giving AI real agency: reading your screen, tapping buttons, running commands, and managing files.

<CardGroup cols={3}>
  <Card title="Local-First" icon="shield">
    All data stays on your device. BYOK model — your keys, your data.
  </Card>
  <Card title="No Hidden Telemetry" icon="eye-off">
    Zero analytics SDKs, zero trackers, zero silent data collection. Verify with any network analysis tool.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Extensible" icon="plug">
    MCP servers, packages, skills, and workflows for infinite capability.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

## What Twent can do

<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="Automate any Android app">
    The AI can see your screen via Accessibility service, tap buttons, fill forms, swipe, scroll, and type — automating any app without API access or special integrations.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Run a full Linux environment">
    Built-in Ubuntu 24.04 terminal — no root required. Install packages with apt, run Python scripts, use Git, SSH to servers, and build software.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Manage files and code">
    Read, write, search, and edit files on your device. Run JavaScript/TypeScript code. Compress, decompress, and transfer files.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Browse the web">
    Fetch web pages as markdown, search with DuckDuckGo/Bing/Scholar, download files, and use a built-in browser with JavaScript execution.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Process media">
    Full FFmpeg engine, camera integration, OCR, image analysis, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech — all built in.
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

## Quick start

1. **Download Twent**

    Get the latest APK from [twent.xyz](https://twent.xyz). The APK is ~80MB and includes everything you need.

2. **Install and grant permissions**

    Open the APK, enable "Install from unknown sources" if prompted, then grant the requested permissions. Storage and Network are required; Accessibility enables UI automation.

3. **Configure your AI provider**

    Go to Settings → Model & Parameters Configuration. Add your API key (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, or many more).

4. **Start chatting**

    Tap the floating bubble or open the chat screen. Ask Twent to do anything — run commands, automate apps, browse the web, or manage files.

:::tip
Twent is completely free. Paid model API usage is billed by your chosen provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.). If someone asks you to pay for Twent itself, it's a scam.
:::

# Automation
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/automation/overview

Twent automates anything on Android — UI automation, shell commands,
 intents, and workflows.


## Methods

 **UI Automation** — control any app by tapping/swiping


 **Shell** — run Linux commands and scripts


 **Intents** — launch apps, send broadcasts


 **Workflows** — multi-step automations with triggers

# Tasker Integration
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/automation/tasker

Connect Twent with the Tasker automation app for advanced scenarios.
 Twent registers as a Tasker plugin — you can trigger Twent from Tasker
 and vice versa.


## Setup
Install Tasker from Play Store

 Enable in `Settings → Integrations → Tasker`

## Example: Battery Monitor


 Tasker profile: Battery

# Chat Styles
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/chat/chat-styles

Two display modes and extensive visual customization.

## Display Modes

 **Cursor style** — character-by-character streaming with
 blinking cursor


 **Bubble style** — traditional chat bubbles with avatars

## Customization


 Set custom wallpapers, adjust colors for light/dark themes, change font
 sizes and message spacing, and configure code block styling. Go to
 `Settings → Theme`.

---

# Floating Chat
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/chat/floating-chat

Use Twent in a floating overlay while doing other things. The AI can see
 your screen and interact with any app.


## Modes

 **Bubble** — small draggable bubble that expands on tap


 **Window** — resizable chat window


 **Fullscreen** — full-screen overlay

## Use Cases


 Get help with what's on screen, ask AI to fill forms, debug while
 reading errors, translate text from any app.

---

# Chat
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/chat/overview

The chat screen is where you interact with your AI assistant. Messages
 stream in word-by-word, tool calls are visible in real time, and all
 conversations are saved locally.


## Key Features

 **Streaming responses** — no waiting for full replies


 **Tool transparency** — see every tool call, parameters,
 and results


 **Conversation management** — edit, branch, lock,
 auto-summarize


 **Shared content** — share files/links from other apps


 **Markdown rendering** — code blocks, tables, LaTeX,
 Mermaid diagrams

## Context Window


 The AI sees your recent conversation history. For long conversations,
 Twent auto-summarizes older messages. Configure in
 `Settings → Context & Summary`.

---

# Your First Chat
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/first-chat

Open the chat screen and type a message. The AI can answer questions,
 run commands, browse the web, manage files, and automate UI
 interactions.


## Try these


```
`What's the weather today?
Create a calorie tracker mini app
Run ls -la in my home directory
Search for the latest AI news`
```


## Tool Calls


 When the AI uses a tool (running a command, reading a file, etc.), you
 see it happen in real time as expandable cards showing the tool name,
 parameters, and results.


## Message Actions


 Long-press any message to **Copy**, **Edit**
 & resend, **Branch** the conversation, or
 **Delete**.

---

# First Setup
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/first-setup

After installing Twent, configure an AI model to talk to. Twent supports
 NVIDIA NIMS, Kilo Gateway, OpenAI, Claude, Deepseek, Gemini, OpenRouter,
 LM Studio, local models (MNN/llama.cpp) and many more.


## Setting up your API key

 Open Twent → `Settings` →
 `Model & Parameters Configuration`

 Tap your provider of choice
 Enter your API key

 Select a model (e.g. `gpt-4o`,
 `claude-sonnet-4-20250514`)

## Local Models


 Run AI completely offline by downloading GGUF or MNN models directly
 on-device. Go to
 `Settings → Model & Parameters Configuration → Local Model`.


## Recommended Models


| Provider | Model |
| --- | --- |
| OpenAI | gpt-5.4 |
| Claude | claude-opus-4.6 |
| OpenRouter | minimax/minimax-m2.7 |

# Installation
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/installation

Twent runs on **Android 8.0+** (API 26).


## Download


 Get the latest release from
 [twent.xyz](https://twent.xyz)
 . The APK is ~80MB and includes the main app, Ubuntu 24 environment,
 local speech recognition (Sherpa-NCNN), and FFmpeg.


## System Requirements


| Requirement | Minimum |
| --- | --- |
| Android version | 8.0 (API 26) |
| RAM | 3GB recommended |
| Storage | 500MB+ free |
| Architecture | arm64-v8a |


 **Note:** Twent is completely free. If someone asks you to
 pay for it, it's a scam.

# Permissions
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/getting-started/permissions

Twent uses Android's permission system to give AI access to device
 capabilities.


## Required

 **Storage** — file management, reading/writing documents


 **Network** — API calls, web browsing, MCP connections

## Optional (Recommended)

 **Accessibility** — UI automation (tap, swipe, read
 screen). The most powerful permission.


 **Display Over Other Apps** — floating chat, screen
 capture


 **Media Projection** — screenshot capture for visual
 automation

## Advanced


| Permission | Enables | Risk |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Storage | Read/write files | Low |
| Network | API calls, web | Low |
| Accessibility | UI automation | Medium |
| ADB | System commands | Medium |
| Root | Full system | High |

---

# Data Deletion Instructions
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/legal/data-deletion

App Name: **Twent**


## How to Delete Your Data


 Twent is a local-first application. We do not store your personal data,
 chat history, or agentic memory on our own servers. All your data is
 stored locally on your device. To delete your data, please follow these
 steps:


## Option 1 (In-App)


 Open the Twent app, navigate to Settings, and tap the "Clear All Local
 Data" button.


## Option 2 (Android System)


 Go to your Android device Settings > Apps > Twent > Storage
 & cache > tap Clear Storage (or Clear Data).


## What Data is Deleted


 Executing the steps above will permanently and immediately delete all
 locally stored data, including:

Chat history and conversation logs.
 Agentic memory and knowledge base entries.
 Saved workflows, templates, and local configurations.
## What Data is Kept / Third-Party Data


 Because Twent operates on a Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) model, your
 prompts and files are sent directly to the third-party AI providers you
 choose (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic). Twent does not retain this data. Any
 data processed by these third-party providers is subject to their
 respective privacy policies and data retention practices.

---

# Memory
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/more/memory

Persistent knowledge storage that survives across conversations. The AI
 remembers your preferences, past discussions, and important information.


## Memory Types

 **User Preferences** — communication style, apps,
 contacts


 **Conversation Summaries** — key decisions and action
 items


 **Knowledge Base** — notes, reference material, research

## Memory Tools


| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| memory_search | Search across all memories |
| memory_save | Save new information |
| memory_update | Update existing memories |
| memory_link | Create relationships between memories |


 All memories are stored **locally** on your device. Nothing
 leaves your device except API calls.

# Settings
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/more/settings

Deep customization — every aspect of Twent is configurable.

## Settings Sections


| Section | What it covers |
| --- | --- |
| Quick Setup | Agent theme, model config, prompts |
| Interface | Theme, display, language, layout |
| Intelligence | API usage, context, summarization |
| Data | Chat sessions, backup, custom headers |
| System | Speech, tool permissions, power user mode |


## Model Configuration


 Support for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, LM Studio, and local
 MNN/llama.cpp models. Configure temperature, max tokens, and other
 parameters per model.


## Themes


 Full visual customization — colors, fonts, spacing, wallpapers. Create
 custom themes and share them. Configure at `Settings → Theme`
 .

# Tool Reference
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/more/tool-reference

Complete parameter reference for all built-in tools.

## read_file


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| path | string | Yes | File path |
| offset | number | No | Start line (1-indexed) |
| limit | number | No | Max lines (default: 500) |


## write_file


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| path | string | Yes | File path |
| content | string | Yes | Content to write |


## terminal


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| command | string | Yes | Command to run |
| timeout | number | No | Max seconds |
| workdir | string | No | Working directory |
| background | boolean | No | Run in background |
| pty | boolean | No | Interactive mode |


## tap


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ref | string | Yes | Element reference ID (@e5) |


## swipe


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| startX | number | Yes | Start X |
| startY | number | Yes | Start Y |
| endX | number | Yes | End X |
| endY | number | Yes | End Y |
| duration | number | No | Duration in ms |


## type


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| text | string | Yes | Text to type |
| ref | string | No | Element to type into |


## scroll


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| direction | string | Yes | up, down, left, right |


## press_key


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| key | string | Yes | back, home, volume_up, etc. |


## open_app


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| packageName | string | Yes | Android package name |


## fetch_url


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| url | string | Yes | URL to fetch |
| max_length | number | No | Max characters |


## memory_search


| Param | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| query | string | Yes | Search query |
| limit | number | No | Max results |

# Toolbox
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/more/toolbox

Built-in utility screens for debugging, development, and system
 management.


## Development Tools

 **Shell Executor** — run commands directly


 **Terminal** — full terminal emulator


 **File Manager** — browse device files


 **SQL Viewer** — query SQLite databases

## System Tools

 **Logcat Viewer** — Android system logs


 **UI Debugger** — inspect UI hierarchy


 **Tool Tester** — test individual tools


 Access via `Settings → Toolbox`.

# Voice
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/more/voice

Speak to your AI and hear it respond. Supports TTS, STT, wake word
 detection, and hands-free conversation mode.


## Text-to-Speech Engines


| Engine | Type |
| --- | --- |
| System TTS | Built-in Android |
| OpenAI TTS | Cloud, 50+ languages |
| SiliconFlow TTS | Cloud, Chinese/English |


## Speech-to-Text Engines


| Engine | Offline |
| --- | --- |
| Sherpa-NCNN | Yes |
| HTTP STT | No |


## Wake Word


 Set a custom trigger phrase in
 `Settings → Speech Services → Wake Word`. The device listens
 for the phrase and starts recording your command.

## Sections

## Publishing


 Share your creations via `Settings → Packages → Publish`.

---

# Packages
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/packages/overview

Extension system for Twent — bundles tools, dependencies, and
 configuration into installable units.


## Package Structure


```
`my-package/
├── package.json # Metadata
├── tools/index.ts # Tool definitions
├── scripts/ # Helper scripts
└── assets/ # Static data`
```


## Installing

 From the marketplace: `Settings → Packages → Marketplace`

 Manual: import ZIP or directory
 Via URL: the AI can install packages for you

---

# Skills
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/packages/skills

Pre-configured behavior bundles that teach the AI how to do specific
 tasks — includes system prompts, tools, workflows, and assets.


## How Skills Work


 When you ask something, Twent checks if any installed skill is relevant.
 If so, it loads that skill's prompts and tools to handle the request.


## Popular Skills


| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Code Review | Analyze code for bugs and security |
| Data Analysis | Process CSVs, generate charts |
| Writing Assistant | Help with writing tasks |
| Research | Deep research on topics |

---

# File System Tools
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/file-system

Read, write, search, and manage files on your device and in the built-in
 Ubuntu environment.


## Available Tools


| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| read_file | Read file contents (with offset/limit) |
| write_file | Write content to a file (creates dirs) |
| patch | Find-and-replace edits in a file |
| search_files | Search inside files or find by name |
| compress/decompress | ZIP, TAR, GZ operations |


## File Locations


| Location | Path |
| --- | --- |
| App data | /data/data/com.ai.assistance.twent/ |
| Internal storage | /sdcard/ or /storage/emulated/0/ |
| Ubuntu environment | ~/ (inside built-in Linux) |

---

# JavaScript Tools
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/javascript

Built-in JS engine for running custom code. Supports file I/O, HTTP,
 JSON, math, and npm packages.


| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| execute_code | Run Python code |

 Install npm packages via the shell, then import them in scripts:

```
`cd /data/data/com.ai.assistance.twent/files/js
npm install axios lodash`
```

# MCP Tools
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/mcp

Model Context Protocol — a standard for giving AI access to external
 tools. Install MCP servers and the AI gets new capabilities.


## Installing

 Browse `Plugins → MCP → Shop Icon`

 Or add manually via JSON config
## Popular Servers


| Server | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Filesystem | Extended file operations |
| Git | Repository management |
| SQLite | Query databases |
| Brave Search | Web search |
| Puppeteer | Browser automation |

# Tools
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/overview

40+ built-in tools give AI real capabilities on your device. Every tool
 call is transparent — you always see what's happening.


| Category | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| File System | Read, write, search, compress files |
| Shell | Run Linux commands, install packages |
| Web | Fetch pages, search, download |
| Media | FFmpeg, camera, OCR, TTS/STT |
| UI Automation | Tap, swipe, type, screenshot |
| JavaScript | Run JS/TS with Node.js |
| MCP | Tools from MCP servers |


## Parallel Execution


 Read-only tools run in parallel automatically — multiple file reads,
 network checks, and device info queries execute simultaneously for
 faster responses.

---

# Shell & Terminal
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/shell

Full Ubuntu 24 environment on your phone — apt, Python, Node.js, vim,
 Git, everything.


## Shell Tools


| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| terminal | Execute commands (supports background, PTY) |


## Package Management


```
`apt update
apt install python3-pip
pip install requests
npm install -g typescript`
```


## Permission Levels


| Level | Access |
| --- | --- |
| Standard | Android shell |
| ADB | pm, am, dumpsys |
| Root | Full su access |
| Shizuku | Elevated without root |

---

# UI Automation
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/tools/ui-automation

The most powerful feature — the AI can see your screen and interact with
 any app via tapping, swiping, and reading the UI tree.


## Tools


| Tool | Description |
| --- | --- |
| tap | Tap a UI element by reference ID |
| swipe | Swipe gesture with coordinates |
| scroll | Scroll up/down/left/right |
| type | Type text into a field |
| screenshot | Capture the screen |
| get_ui_tree | Get full UI element hierarchy |
| press_key | Back, Home, Volume, etc. |
| open_app | Launch an app by package name |


## Dual Pipeline


 Twent uses both the Accessibility UI tree AND visual screenshots to
 understand your screen. Every tool call automatically captures screen
 context before executing.


## Permission Levels


| Mode | Requirement | Capability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Accessibility | Enable service | Tap, type, scroll, read UI |
| ADB | USB debugging | System-level automation |
| Root | Rooted device | Full access |
| Shizuku | Shizuku running | Elevated without root |

---

# Workflow Examples
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/workflows/examples

## Morning Briefing


 Trigger: Daily at 7:30am. Steps: get calendar events → get weather → AI
 summarizes → send notification.


## File Backup


 Trigger: Daily at midnight. Steps: list files → compress → upload to
 cloud → notify.


## Low Battery Alert


 Trigger: Battery below 15%. Steps: get battery details → get running
 apps → AI recommends which to close → notify.

---

# Workflows
Source: https://twent.xyz/docs/workflows/overview

Multi-step automations combining triggers, conditions, and actions.

## Workflow Types

 **Simple** — one trigger, one action


 **Chained** — multiple actions in sequence


 **Conditional** — if/else branching


 **Scheduled** — run on a schedule

## Trigger Types


| Trigger | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Schedule | Cron-based timing |
| Interval | Every N minutes/hours |
| App Launch | When an app opens |
| Notification | On incoming notification |
| Battery | On battery level change |
| Wake Word | Voice trigger phrase |
